title: Imax 70 mm screenings become the biggest star for Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’
summary_full: Moviegoers are traveling, lining up and paying premiums to see Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ in scarce Imax 70 mm screenings.
summary_public: Moviegoers are traveling, lining up and paying premiums to see Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ in scarce Imax 70 mm screenings.
